facets.definition: As a main contribution or evaluation target: Persistent memory updates, supersession, conflict resolution or versioning.
facets.label: Revision and update semantics

facets.definition: Memory content whose validity explicitly depends on context, user, role, situation or ownership, including defaults with exceptions. Document-region retrieval scope alone does not qualify.
facets.label: Scope and context

facets.definition: Explicit validity intervals, time-bounded facts, expiry, temporary validity or versioned time for memory. A generic timeline, temporal coherence or timing of computation does not qualify.
facets.label: Temporal validity and expiry

facets.definition: As a main contribution or evaluation target: Persistent memory deletion, revocation, forgetting or removal of derived memory.
facets.label: Forgetting and deletion

facets.definition: Explicit memory write or admission policy, memory provenance tracking or memory audit. General agent authorization or AI governance without memory-specific policy does not qualify.
facets.label: Governance, admission and provenance

facets.definition: As a main contribution or evaluation target: Security of agent memory, poisoning, adversarial manipulation, attacks or leakage.
facets.label: Security and poisoning

facets.definition: As a main contribution or evaluation target: Benchmarks and methods evaluating persistent agent memory, including state-level evaluation.
facets.label: Evaluation methodology

facets.definition: A proposed, analyzed or evaluated persistent agent-memory architecture, storage organization or consolidation mechanism as a main contribution or evaluation target. Generic agent architecture with memory as a component does not qualify.
facets.label: Memory architecture

facets.definition: A proposed, analyzed or evaluated method for retrieving persistent agent memory as a main contribution or evaluation target. Merely using a retrieval system or mentioning retrieval does not qualify.
facets.label: Retrieval method

facets.definition: As a main contribution or evaluation target: Asking for clarification or abstaining when persistent memory is ambiguous, conflicting or unsupported.
facets.label: Clarification and abstention

inclusion: A facet is eligible only when the title or abstract explicitly identifies it as a main contribution or evaluation target; incidental background, examples or an application domain are insufficient. Each positive tag must cite an exact supplied title or abstract sentence.
recall_limit: A not-stated matrix cell means no supporting passage found in the supplied retrieval context, not proof of absence.
stability_metric: Pairwise adjusted Rand index across five full-data fits (10 pairs); also report jointly assigned denominators and noise-confounded all-paper ARI.
